Where do you begin and could be a logical, easy first step? Go Green IT can help with this. Please contact us to discuss your thoughts we will do our best to help with your unique situation. Hosting One way of reducing costs is to virtualise your servers and infrastructure. This is also something we can help with, whether it's converting physical servers to virtual machines, creating a system from scratch, or managing what you already have in an efficient manor. Feel free to contact us for a discussion on the options available. GOGREEN IT Some testimonials: Splendid Hotels tab 2 "The property hardware upgrade was a daunting task for us. Their work on our software upgrades and installing new hardware has made a significant different to our business. We’ve seen a major increase in the speed of the internet and quote requests from the websites which has been pretty remarkable. Our PMS now working properly, all external websites integrated well and deliver information in time. Would definitely recommend GoGreen IT services to everyone." - GM at The New Ellington, Leeds second sub block Contact Us! So far, one was great, one was good, and two were poor: "Gigabit Power-over-Ethernet Extender, PoE Passthrough Switch" Several of these were bought from Anazon for £75-90 over the last couple of years. They are not cheap, but work at 10, 100 and 1000mbps at both full and half-duplex. There is no management capability, nor "VLAN" or "length extension" switches, but it just works: Sadly there's no real make or model on the device, so I can only go by my previous order or check the picture when re-ordering. It has optional wall-mounting brackets, which is also handy. PoE Passthrough Switch, 1 PoE in 3 PoE Out Extender, IEEE802.3af/at PoE Powered, 100Mbps Ethernet, din-rail & Wall Mount £20 from Amazon, July 2024 Although it's not listed as such, I think the make is "Binardat". Note that on the bottom, it specifically says it supports 10mbps: However, when 10mbps devices were plugged in, no traffic is passed, although the LEDs flash like there is activity. This device was returned to Amazon.
